summary: Resolved all nine findings from the single permitted Sol/high specification cold read, native session 01a09b0e-d563-71e2-9cce-7c8eb51074f2. The amended capability now follows Decisions 0067 and 0074, makes handoff, context, review identity and migration coverage falsifiable, and leaves concrete formats to architecture and task contracts.
gaps: The specification named D-0034 before the deferral ledger assigned that identifier.
Ordinary-chat handoff state had no durable observable.
Review fingerprint identity required start and end data the provider does not supply.
Cross-lens consistency relied on undefined free-form assessment grammar.
The context-file capability was simultaneously optional to implement and required by acceptance.
Unknown capacity limits could disable every ordinary composed launch.
Migration eligibility lacked roots and a non-vacuous coverage predicate.
The capability layer duplicated filenames, schemas, algorithms, limits and host signals owned by architecture and task contracts.
resolutions: The deferral ledger now assigns the completed native combined-review work D-0034 and records that older FORGE-COORD-1 references to D-0032 are its historical alias; upstream keeps its shipped D-0032.
Spec, signoff and epics rounds use empty scope only without an active story; from an active story location they bind that story and an empty task exactly as Decision 0067 requires.
Main raises the existing story-scoped blocked signal before a required ordinary-chat question; abandonment leaves the signal open for session start, next-step, readiness and a later coordinator.
The capability states that the provider's one integer line becomes both normalized start and end.

Cross-lens enforcement is now deterministic: a finding has one lens tag, duplicate normalized identity under another lens refuses, and existing verdict and worst-result rules determine blocking; assessment prose carries no separate fingerprint grammar.
The workflow task must implement optional context-file support; callers may omit it, and supplied input is complete and capacity checked.
Only a launch that supplies supplemental context refuses when its installed or local byte limit is unknown; ordinary launches retain their existing behavior.

Migration inventories both task-scoped fixed triples and uniquely task-bound story-scoped triples, and a fresh independent walk must match its count and digest, so empty succeeds only when no eligible set exists.

The cited review, setup and migration sections now state observable capability outcomes and explicitly leave concrete filenames, schema fields, marker grammar, algorithms, limits, flags and host signals to architecture and task contracts.
